DECLARE @PROCESSNAME VARCHAR(1000), @CONFIGID INT

SET @PROCESSNAME = @ProcessName_DWA1

SELECT @CONFIGID = CONFIGID FROM DX_EDI.DBO.EdiConfig WHERE PROCESSNAME = @PROCESSNAME 

INSERT INTO [EdiConfig_CopyProcess]
(ConfigID, SourceConnection, TargetConnection, MarketName, MarketState, ProcessName, WorkflowName, BaseParmFilename, WhereClause, OutFilename, DestinationPath, ArchivePath, MaxClaimsPerFile, StripCarriageReturns, SuccessEmail1, ErrorEmail, RunFrequency, LastRunDate, NextRunDate, OverrideRunDate, RunNow, TransactionTypeCode, UsageIndicator, InsuranceType, SenderId, SenderName, ReceiverId, ReceiverName, PayerId, PayerName, PayerAddress1, PayerAddress2, PayerCity, PayerState, PayerZip, LastModifiedDate, LastModifiedBy, Active, RunStartDate, RunExpirationDate, BaseWorkflow, PER02, PER03, PER04, PER05, PER06, PER07, PER08, DoRollup, IncludeZeroPayCOB, Notes, NcpdpDetailRecordType, NcpdpHeaderRecordType, NcpdpTrailerRecordType, NcpdpVersionNumber, NcpdpTransmissionAction, NcpdpSubmissionNumber, NcpdpRecordIndicator, NcpdpSplitOnBatch, EmailChangeNotification, GRGR_CKs, GRGR_IDs, KeepClaimHistory, OutFilenameBC, DRE_OUT_ID, DRE_EXCD_ID, ISA05, ISA07, SqlTextExcel, RunExcelFlag, ExcelPath, REF_2010AC, REF_2010BB )

SELECT ConfigID, SourceConnection, TargetConnection, MarketName, MarketState, ProcessName, WorkflowName, BaseParmFilename, WhereClause, OutFilename, DestinationPath, ArchivePath, MaxClaimsPerFile, StripCarriageReturns, SuccessEmail1, ErrorEmail, RunFrequency, LastRunDate, NextRunDate, OverrideRunDate, RunNow, TransactionTypeCode, UsageIndicator, InsuranceType, SenderId, SenderName, ReceiverId, ReceiverName, PayerId, PayerName, PayerAddress1, PayerAddress2, PayerCity, PayerState, PayerZip, LastModifiedDate, LastModifiedBy, Active, RunStartDate, RunExpirationDate, BaseWorkflow, PER02, PER03, PER04, PER05, PER06, PER07, PER08, DoRollup, IncludeZeroPayCOB, Notes, NcpdpDetailRecordType, NcpdpHeaderRecordType, NcpdpTrailerRecordType, NcpdpVersionNumber, NcpdpTransmissionAction, NcpdpSubmissionNumber, NcpdpRecordIndicator, NcpdpSplitOnBatch, EmailChangeNotification, GRGR_CKs, GRGR_IDs, KeepClaimHistory, OutFilenameBC, DRE_OUT_ID, DRE_EXCD_ID, ISA05, ISA07, SqlTextExcel, RunExcelFlag, ExcelPath, REF_2010AC, REF_2010BB 
FROM DX_EDI.DBO.EDICONFIG  
WHERE PROCESSNAME = @PROCESSNAME


DELETE FROM DX_EDI.DBO.EdiConfig WHERE PROCESSNAME = @PROCESSNAME 


INSERT INTO [EdiMappletSql_CopyProcess]
( SqlID, ConfigId, MappletName, [Loop], Segment, MappletSql, LastModifiedDate, LastModifiedBy, SEQ_NO, Active, UseDefault)

SELECT  SqlID, ConfigId, MappletName, [Loop], Segment, MappletSql, LastModifiedDate, LastModifiedBy, SEQ_NO, Active, UseDefault FROM DX_EDI.DBO.EdiMappletSql WHERE CONFIGID = @CONFIGID 
select * FROM DX_EDI.DBO.EdiMappletSql 


DELETE FROM DX_EDI.DBO.EdiMappletSql WHERE CONFIGID = @CONFIGID
